Birrius</AUTHOR> to <EDITOR>Ant. Birrius</EDITOR> for semantic correctness (editor, not author). 4) Fixed 8 mojibake UTF-8 mis-encodings: Buchl√§den->Buchläden, ausgel√§ffert->ausgeliefert, sch√∂n->schön, √†->à, k√ºnfftige->künftige, Prei√ü->Preiß, w√§hret->währet, bi√ü->biß. 5) Normalized whitespace/punctuation inside BIBL and moved non-bibliographic advertisement text ('künftige Wochen...' + YEAR/PRIZE) outside second BIBL.
